blurb: Guests can rent street-legal golf carts to explore Key West, participate in an all-inclusive watersports package including jet ski, parasail, snorkeling, and more, or rent beach equipment like kayaks and paddleboards at Smathers Beach. The watersports package includes multiple activities, lunch, and drinks. Golf carts are street-legal and require insurance to operate on public roads.
